description: Business design source for trial amounts. It does not configure the application or authorize execution, payment or material transfer.
principles: Scope classification is a required independent input. This file is not an implemented automatic scope recognizer.
Unknown or unsupported scope receives no executable low-price quote.
Only independent business objectives and outputs count; no token, call, paragraph, question-number or source-file billing.
Original-scope correction/evidence completion is included even if the original price was under-estimated.
Coverage credit is a previously purchased valid entitlement, not an unrestricted monetary coupon.
A change of technical document hash alone is not a new business target revision.
Evidence reuse does not make every future independent output free. The incremental output must be explicit.
Same-goal reply and necessary prospectus application belong to the agreed combined business outcome, not two analysis charges.
New third-party reply outputs using existing financial facts are direct replies only, unless already included or merely clarification of the old delivery.
Financial cap is for the same locked business target, not a lifetime issuer ceiling.
Basic linked-file check and financial-group review have different coverage and are not an automatic upgrade ladder.
Company net-profit qualification requires actual weighted complete costs and fixed budget. These prices alone do not ensure 60%.
A 249 period package includes required baseline repair, alignment and restatement; these are not add-on SKUs.
Financial target revisions cannot reset for unrelated non-financial facts, replies or technical/project names.
Classify independent residual output after analysis reuse; no invented analysis discount.
ruleRevision: Necessary financial repair/restatement included; financial target identity and residual work clarified. Amounts unchanged.
